messages:
ravi: noticed sudden spike in model-serving errors after last quant rollout. 5xx up ~0.9% global, concentrated on long-context customers. proposing hotfix image redwood/modelserv:qc-hotfix-031 and expedited approval. need cut in next 45m.
jia: can you own the deploy? what's rollback signal? any customer-facing migrations?
ravi: i'll own deploy. rollback criteria: global 5xx +0.4% absolute OR p99 latency >2s for 3m. no migrations. memory leak guard: abort if pod RSS >1.7GB for 2 nodes.
deploy-bot: Release requested: redwood/modelserv:qc-hotfix-031. Canary plan: 5% -> 15% (10m) -> 50% (5m) -> 100%. ETA start 1848881290.
sre-oncall: oncall here, ack. i'll monitor and can trigger rollback. set incident tag: INC-184888.
jia: legal asked for a short blurb confirming no data retention changes before we publish release notes. @legal please confirm.
legal: confirmed no privacy or retention changes. approve release note text after deploy.
release-eng: add to notes: "Fix quantization kernel edge-case causing incorrect attention slicing under long contexts; no data migrations." also remind customers in the notes to retry failing requests.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1848881290 on pool modelserv-canary-1 (5%).
ravi: quick smoke in canary: 5xx 0.04%, p99 380ms. looks clean.
sre-oncall: dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/s/modelserv/qc-hotfix-031. watching errors and mem.
deploy-bot: Advanced to 15% at 1848881350. Hold 10m verification.
jia: running synthetic long-context suite against canary nodes now.
ravi: synthetic suite clean so far.
sre-oncall: error rate steady, no memory spikes. Holding.
deploy-bot: Advanced to 50% at 1848881410. Hold 5m.
release-eng: prep final notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/1848881234-note. will post after full roll.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1848881370. No automated rollback.
ravi: deployed to 100%. monitoring passive traffic for 20m. will publish short incident summary and link to release notes.
jia: thanks everyone. please tag any follow-ups in the incident. :thumbsup:
